userMessage.content:
Refine the existing ÓRBITA design after a real browser review. Preserve its successful Mars field-manual identity, original photographs, catalog, 312 variant combinations, functional native grouped selectors, prices, stock, cart and routes. Do not rebuild the whole store or duplicate products. Make these targeted corrections:

1. All small icons currently render as broken images (shopping bag, arrows and FAQ chevrons). In components/site.tsx the shared Icon uses a dynamic `/assets/icons/${name}.svg` img source. Make every icon render reliably in the compiled hosted iframe. Use the platform's supported icon mechanism or explicit bundled literal asset references that are actually present; alternatively small inline vector UI icons if permitted by the platform. No broken-image symbols, and no remote dependencies.
2. On the 1440px desktop homepage, the huge title wraps its final period onto a separate fifth line. Make intentional line breaks with EQUIPO / PARA / OTROS / MUNDOS, keep the period attached to MUNDOS or remove the period, and size the typography so it fits comfortably in its column. Keep it bold and striking. The campaign statement and primary CTA should remain near the first fold, rather than pushed far down by a tall headline. At 390px ensure the headline and actions also fit without horizontal overflow.
3. The desktop hero photograph is center-cropped so the hiker on the far right is completely invisible. Adjust the image focal point/crop so the hiker and backpack are clearly visible at desktop and mobile widths. Preserve the supplied image exactly, with no replacement or regeneration. A focal point toward the right of the photo is essential.
4. The checkout has two page titles and duplicated return navigation. Its first heading REGISTRO DE EXPEDICIÓN is so large (around 160px) that the actual order review is below the fold. Make checkout a compact functional extension of the brand: one concise page-title hierarchy, a modest editorial kicker, readable order summary and clear next-step button near the top. Style the actual runtime-generated checkout elements. Avoid a giant ornamental title before the real order review. Keep the existing supported checkout hook functional.

Verified behavior to preserve: choosing Parka Cráter 01 / Hueso / M / Amplio / Kit completo shows Bs 1.085,00, adds exactly that variant to the cart, and carries it to the checkout review. The mobile option buttons already fit the page. Retain the direct visible data-cart-open controls in the JSX for every route so platform validation passes.

Use customer-friendly FAQ language about Complementos: choose no additions, an individual addition, or the complete kit; the displayed price includes the selection. Remove implementation wording about “cuarto grupo de variantes”. This is a focused visual/wording repair, with no changes to catalog data.

steps.label: Comprobando el código y los recursos

answers.context:
ÓRBITA conserva su identidad de manual editorial de expedición marciana: hueso #F0EEE6, tinta #191B19, bermellón #EF451F, tipografía condensada, códigos monoespaciados, reglas técnicas, motivos orbitales y fotografías reales. Mantener los cuatro productos existentes y sus 312 combinaciones, IDs, precios y stock; no duplicar ni modificar catálogo. Preservar selectores nativos agrupados, carrito, checkout y rutas. Fotografías existentes: campaña marciana en hero con excursionista a la derecha; Parka hueso, Mochila bermellón, Botella grafito y Kit con estuche/parches. Cada detalle conserva “Fotografía del color de portada”. Prueba crítica a preservar: Parka Cráter 01 / Hueso / M / Amplio / Kit completo cuesta Bs 1.085,00 y debe llegar como esa variante exacta al carrito y checkout. Footer: “Colección conceptual · Tienda de demostración”. Reparación solicitada: eliminar iconos rotos, corregir saltos y escala del titular, enfocar el hero hacia la derecha, compactar checkout y humanizar la explicación de Complementos.
Las imágenes ya presentes en la revisión aprobada conservan su uso y ubicación. Este pedido no autoriza reclasificarlas como referencia, retirarlas ni sustituirlas por dibujos. El resumen histórico y la interpretación automática no amplían el pedido actual.
